programme.notes: KB programme status is unknown for UTokyo (CS is reached via 理科一類 and the late-specialisation 進学選択, Japanese-taught); not re-researched here.

english.quote: ③ TOEFL iBT又はIELTS（国際英語能力テスト。アカデミックモジュール）を出 願開始日前2年以内に受験していること。
english.notes: 2027年度 東京大学外国学校卒業学生特別選考募集要項, 第1種（私費留学生）: a TOEFL iBT or IELTS Academic score taken within 2 years before the application start is REQUIRED, but no minimum score is published. Japanese-medium admission: EJU (日本留学試験) 'Japanese' plus science/maths subjects required; the essay must be answered in Japanese and the interview is in Japanese. The quote's space inside '出 願' is a line break in the PDF.

gpa.notes: No grade minimum in the 2027 外国学校卒業学生特別選考 guidelines (PDF https://www.u-tokyo.ac.jp/content/400291798.pdf): first stage is a holistic review of submitted documents ('提出された出願書類を総合的に審査し'), second stage essay + interview. EJU subjects are required without published thresholds.

value.population: all undergraduates (same for private international students)

tuition.notes: Section Ⅲ その他 1 入学料・授業料 of the 2027 guidelines: entrance fee 282,000 yen (planned), tuition 642,960 yen per year (planned amount, 予定額; subject to revision). Academic year inferred from the 2027年度 guidelines (April 2027 entry).
